categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label, modifies `src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp` descriptor expansion logic and adds functional test in `test/functional/wallet_importdescriptors.py`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a correctness and reliability bug where ranged descriptor imports starting at index N derive keys from 0, causing import times to scale with M rather than M - N (benchmark: 19.5s to 0.09s for [600000, 600009]), potential memory exhaustion on high range starts up to 2^31, and inconsistent `IsMine` tracking across restarts.
